title: Ethylene epoxidation reference family
reaction: C2H4 + 1/2 O2 -> C2H4O (ethylene oxide; competing combustion: C2H4 + 3 O2 -> 2 CO2 + 2 H2O)
objective: Optional literature-backed family for industrial ethylene oxide (EO) production. Candidates compare an Ag / alpha-Al2O3 baseline (the 50-year canonical industrial catalyst), a Cs-promoted Ag / Al2O3 high-selectivity variant (industrial standard), and an Ag-Cs-Re / Al2O3 high-selectivity emerging variant (Re-promoted commercial-grade).

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance catalyst cost, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported EO selectivity / activity.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and reproducible Ag / Al2O3 epoxidation routes.

citations.label: J. Catal. 2003
citations.note: Linic et al.: construction of a reaction coordinate and a microkinetic model for ethylene epoxidation on silver from DFT calculations and surface-science experiments.

citations.label: J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2003
citations.note: Linic and Barteau: control of ethylene epoxidation selectivity by surface oxametallacycles, foundational identification of the EO selectivity intermediate.

citations.label: Appl. Catal. A 2003
citations.note: Ayame, Uchida et al.: epoxidation of ethylene over silver catalysts on alpha-alumina crystal carriers, characterising the dominant industrial support choice.

citations.label: J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2004
citations.note: Linic and Barteau: mechanism of Cs promotion in ethylene epoxidation on Ag, supporting the industrial Cs-promoted Ag formulation.

citations.label: ChemCatChem 2010
citations.note: Christopher and Linic: shape- and size-specific chemistry of Ag nanostructures in catalytic ethylene epoxidation, demonstrating particle-morphology selectivity control.

citations.label: ChemCatChem 2010
citations.note: Ozbek, Onal et al.: review of ethylene epoxidation catalysed by silver oxide, organising mechanism and surface-state hypotheses.

citations.label: J. Catal. 2015
citations.note: Diao, DiGiulio et al.: investigation on the role of Re as a promoter in Ag-Cs-Re / alpha-Al2O3 high-selectivity ethylene epoxidation catalysts; closest reference to current commercial high-selectivity formulations.

citations.label: Mol. Catal. 2017
citations.note: Ren and Xu: origin of enhanced ethylene oxide selectivity by Cs-promoted silver catalyst, complementary to Linic 2004 mechanism.

route_templates.name: Ag / alpha-Al2O3 baseline route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Supported Ag on alpha-alumina ethylene epoxidation catalyst
route_templates.route_note: Most transferable ethylene-epoxidation basis using Ag on alpha-alumina, the 50-year industrial catalyst architecture.

route_templates.name: Ag-Cs / Al2O3 high-selectivity route
synthesis: Ag and Cs sequential or co-impregnation
route_templates.route_note: Industrial high-selectivity Cs-promoted Ag route; Cs promoter widens the EO selectivity window over the bare-Ag baseline.

route_templates.name: Ag-Cs-Re / Al2O3 modern industrial route
preprocess: Ag, Cs and Re precursor balancing
synthesis: Sequential impregnation of Ag, Cs, and Re
route_templates.route_note: Re-promoted high-selectivity industrial route; the closest reference to current commercial high-selectivity formulations.

candidates.title: Ag / alpha-Al2O3 baseline
candidates.summary: Bare Ag on alpha-alumina; the canonical ethylene-oxide catalyst architecture used as the cost and process anchor.
decision_notes: Most transferable ethylene-epoxidation basis with mature commercial inputs.
Without a promoter, EO selectivity is meaningfully lower than industrial Cs- or Cs/Re-promoted catalysts.

pricing.note: Live Ag feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup for commercial Ag / Al2O3 ethylene-oxide screening.
Alpha-alumina support cost held on engineering proxy; alpha phase carries a small premium over gamma.

candidates.title: Ag-Cs / Al2O3 (industrial standard)
candidates.summary: Cs-promoted Ag on alpha-alumina; the dominant commercial high-selectivity ethylene-oxide catalyst.
decision_notes: Best fit for high-selectivity industrial duty without paying for Re-promotion overhead.
Catalyst economics dominated by Ag; Cs is a small fraction of cost but widens the selectivity window meaningfully.

pricing.note: Live Ag feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup.
Cs salt cost held on a derived screening proxy reflecting bulk cesium salt pricing.
Alpha-alumina support cost held on engineering proxy.

candidates.title: Ag-Cs-Re / Al2O3 (modern HSE)
candidates.summary: Re-promoted Cs / Ag on alpha-alumina; the closest published reference to current modern industrial high-selectivity ethylene-oxide catalysts (>85% EO selectivity).
decision_notes: Best fit for the highest-selectivity industrial duty when Re-promoter overhead is acceptable.
Re exposure is small but Re prices are high; promoter precursor accounting dominates non-Ag cost.

pricing.note: Live Ag feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup.
Cs salt cost held on the same derived screening proxy as the Ag-Cs candidate.
Live Re feed with a precursor / conversion markup; Re promoter discipline drives the selectivity uplift.
Alpha-alumina support cost held on engineering proxy.
